sources.title: fine-tuned-model-indonesian-2 by Hendri Mardani: Open Model
sources.snippet: fine-tuned-model-indonesian-2 is an open-weight model for text generation from Hendri Mardani. It has 8B parameters and a 131,072-token context. At 16-bit it needs about 19.3 GB of GPU memory, which fits on 1x MI300X from $1.85 an hour, at the lowest prices in the SAVRN Index. It draws 810 downloads a month.
